name: CF-Div2-Stepfun
intro: CF-Div2-Stepfun 是一个评测大型语言模型竞赛编程能力的基准，选取2024年9月至2025年2月的CodeForces Division 2比赛题目以防止数据泄露。基准采用严格的离线沙箱评分，包含大量边界和压力测试，全面检验模型表现。
build_method: 新近Codeforces Div.2题目筛选, 小规模与随机大规模测试, 对抗与hack用例, 压力测试验证
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10604 Appendix E.2.1: CF-Div2-Stepfun is a custom CodeForces Div.2 benchmark for evaluating fresh competition-level coding ability. It contains 53 problems sourced from official CodeForces Div.2 contests held from September 2024 to February 2025, uses an offline local grading framework instead of real-time online submissions, constructs tests similar to original cases by first generating small-scale correctness cases, then randomized large-scale cases, and finally adversarial edge cases from common error patterns and hacked submissions. Additional edge cases are generated through stress testing until failed submissions can be separated from correct ones. Reliability is checked by running accepted and representative failed original submissions, identifying 100% of accepted submissions as Passed and flagging 92.45% of failed submissions, then scoring models with avg@8, pass@8, and simplified competitive ratings under standardized compile and execution commands.
build_method_en: Recent Codeforces Div.2 Selection, Small and Randomized Large Tests, Adversarial and Hacked Cases, Stress-test Validation
intro_en: CF-Div2-Stepfun is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' coding abilities, using CodeForces Division 2 problems from September 2024 to February 2025 to prevent data leakage. It employs strict offline sandbox scoring and includes extensive boundary and stress tests to comprehensively assess model performance.
